chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْهَ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh and Ibrahim, from Ayyub, from Ibn al-Mughira, from Ali ibn Ismail ibn Ammar, from Ishaq who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: إِنَّا لَنَا أَمْوَالٌ وَنَحْنُ نُعَامِلُ النَّاسَ، وَ أَخَافُ إِنْ حَدَثَ حَدَثٌ أَنْ تُغْرَقَ أَمْوَالُنَا، قَالَ: اجْمَعْ مَالَكَ فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ رَبِيعٌ، قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ: فَمَاتَ إِسْحَاقُ فِي شَهْرِ رَبِيعٍ

translations.en: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): We have wealth and we deal with the people [lending it to them], and I fear that if an event occurs, our wealth will be lost [perish in their hands]. He said: Collect your wealth every month of Rabi'. Ali ibn Ismail said: And Ishaq died in the month of Rabi'.

en.summary: This narration from *Rijal al-Kashi* highlights the concept of *al-Rabi'* (springing forth or renewal) as a protective measure for wealth against unforeseen loss, reflecting the Imam's practical wisdom in financial management. The specific mention of the month of Rabi' serves as a divine sign (*ishara*) confirming the accuracy of the Imam's guidance, a common theme in Shia hadith literature where temporal details validate spiritual authority. It underscores the importance of regular financial review and liquidity to mitigate the risks of debt and trade in Islamic economics.
en.seo_question: What financial advice did Imam al-Sadiq give regarding wealth held by others?

key_terms.رَبِيعٌ: Rabi' (a month of the lunar calendar)
